column1: # Every cadrei allow input from the bash 0.2.0 reviews (cadrei-review-kit) and smoke.sh, with the
# outcome of the approved bash checker in two fake-HOME layouts: plain, and stow-style
# (~/.config and ~/.ssh as symlinks into ~/dotfiles). Columns: source, kind (R rule, A --auto),
# input, plain outcome, plain message, stow outcome, stow message. {HOME}, {CADREI} (named demo),
# {PARENT}, {OTHER} (a second known cadrei) and {ROOT} stand for the layout's paths.
